svg.title: Leave-one-driver-out validation
svg.desc: Each fold trains on twelve DMD drivers and evaluates on one completely unseen driver, then driver-level results are bootstrapped for confidence intervals.

svg.text: Validation asks: does it work on a person it has never seen?
Random frame splits answer an easier question and leak driver-specific appearance and motion patterns.
Frames within one driver are correlated.
Resampling frames would make intervals artificially tight.
